Hi Jordan \u0014

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Use case: low-latency payment reconciliation assistant (high throughput, bursts around batch jobs)
- Primary decision criteria: throughput per dollar, predictable latency under 150ms P95, and data controls for transaction data (audit logs + KMS)
- Stakeholders you mentioned: Elena Ruiz (CFO / economic buyer), Maya Patel (security lead), and procurement@acme-fintech.com for PO/payment

Next steps we discussed:
1) I'll send a short vendor onboarding packet and a draft SOW + pricing for Elena to review.
2) We can run a short perf benchmark on your test data after NDA if that helps accelerate technical approval.
3) Procurement to confirm PO timing and invoicing details so we can align delivery (dedicated capacity / start date).

Requested from your side: please confirm the procurement contact + expected PO timeline, and whether Elena prefers to review pricing before or after security sign-off.

I've attached our standard Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx to keep things moving \u0014 if procurement has a different form, happy to fill that out. Also attaching a short pricing sheet and a draft SOW (internal draft).

Thanks \u0014
Marissa

Procurement notes:
